name: Herdr PiP
description: A floating badge with Herdr agent status (blocked, done, working) that stays visible over fullscreen windows. Click it to pick an agent: Herdr focuses that agent and the terminal window running herdr is raised. Runs the herdr CLI (agent list, agent focus); does not launch anything else. Exposes OpenMenu and Focus on the session D-Bus (io.github.hungify.HerdrPip) so the menu can be opened when a fullscreen app blocks shortcuts. Not affiliated with Herdr.
